en: Improved Dolby Vision playback, thumbnails, and Motion+ compatibility.
Faster video opening and more reliable playback from network drives.
Fixed incorrect orientation in some videos.
More control over subtitle generation: wait for the current task or stop it when switching videos.
zh: 改进 Dolby Vision 播放、缩略图及 Motion+ 兼容性。
视频打开更快，网络硬盘播放更稳定。
修复部分视频方向不正确的问题。
生成新视频的字幕时，可选择等待或停止上一项任务。
